interventions.detail: Resolved paddlenlp 3.0.0b4 deps with uv --exclude-newer 2025-03-20 (latest aistudio-sdk removed aistudio_sdk.hub.download, breaking import)
Installed setuptools and pip into the venv; paddle imports setuptools and paddlenlp imports pip but neither is declared
Used Python 3.10 venv via uv instead of system Python 3.12
Installed CPU paddlepaddle 3.0.0 from paddle CPU index and used dtype float32 instead of float16
